notes.title: Version 1.0.10 is live! Italian language added!
notes.notes:
Hello dear members of #vamily! I hope my message finds you well!

It’s my great pleasure to inform you that the waiting is finally over and you can now play Vampire: The Masquerade: Coteries of New York in Italian!

Thank you so much for your patience and understanding! It has been a long process, but thanks to the hard work and skills of Coteries’ Italian translator, Mattia, and great effort made by our QA and implementation team, the update is now live!

Next to adding Italian (and Spanish!) language to the game, the latest patch (version 1.0.10) also includes a few fixes, listed below:


 implemented fix to one of Jackie's lines in The Kaiser's Lackey quest
 implemented minor fixes to the French translation
 minor bug fixes

For those of you, who already composed their own coterie of vampires, take a look at Shadows of New York - a standalone continuation of Coteries, which lets you play Julia Sowinski, a young Lasombra Kindred, investigating the Final Death of one of the most influential vampires in New York city! Go through the trailer and the game's description and if you like what you see, buy Shadows of New York right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279630/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Shadows_of_New_York/

We encourage all of you to join our official Discord server, where you can talk directly with both Coteries’ and Shadows’ developers!

Thank you for your ongoing trust and continuous support!

Take care and stay healthy!

Best regards,
Jacek @ Draw Distance dev team 

///

Ciao a tutti i membri della #vamily! Spero che stiate tutti bene!

È con mio grande piacere che mi ritrovo ad annunciarvi che l'attesa è finita e che sarà finalmente possibile giocare a Vampire: The Masquerade: Coteries of New York in italiano!

Vi ringraziamo per la pazienza e la comprensione! C'è voluto molto lavoro, ma grazie al duro lavoro di Mattia, il traduttore di Coteries e agli sforzi del nostro QA team, l'update è finalmente pronto!

Oltre ad aggiungere la lingua italiana (e anche spagnola!) al gioco, l'ultima patch (versione 1.0.10) include anche le seguenti correzioni:


 sistemati errori in una delle frasi di Jackie nella questline di Kaiser
 aggiustamenti con la versione in francese
 risoluzione di bug minori

Per chi ha già avuto modo di formare la propria coterie di vampiri, vi consigliamo di dare un'occhiata a Shadows of New York - un capitolo autoconclusivo collegato a Coteries nel quale vestirete i panni di Julia Sowinski, una giovane Lasombra intenta ad investigare la Morte Ultima di uno dei vampiri più influenti di New York! Godetevi il trailer e leggete la descrizione del gioco e, se dovesse piacervi, acquistate subito Shadows of New York!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279630/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Shadows_of_New_York/

Vi invitiamo a unirvi al nostro server Discord ufficiale, dove potrete parlare direttamente con gli sviluppatori di Coteries e Shadows!

Vi ringraziamo per la vostra fiducia e per il vostro supporto!

Cordiali saluti,
Jacek @ Draw Distance dev team

notes.title: Version 1.0.9 now available on Mac OS!
notes.notes:
Hello dear members of #vamily, how are you?

I'm pleased to announce that Vampire: The Masquerade: Coteries of New York in its latest version (1.0.9) is now available on Mac OS!

This means that from now on Mac OS users have access to the latest set of changes and fixes:


 Addition of two new language versions: simplified Chinese and Russian
 Dictionary and Log improvements for Large font size.
 Fixes to existing translations (FR, BR-PT).
 Several fixes to audio issues.
 Several small issues in Dialogue structure fixed.
 Corrected instances of outdated English text.


We're very sorry that you, our fans playing on Mac OS, had to wait so long for the update. Good thing is that Apple finally dealt with their internal issues and from now on every future update should land very close to the Windows update (it will depend only on our QA!)

As always, we encourage all of you to join our official Discord channel, where you can talk directly with our developers.

Thank you for your continuous support and engagement. 

Take care and stay healthy!
Jacek @ Draw Distance dev team

notes.title: Update regarding the Russian language version
notes.notes:
Hello dear members of #vamily! I hope my message finds you well!

We have an important update for our Russian community regarding the localization of Vampire: The Masquerade - Coteries of New York. Here's a statement from the project lead on Coteries:

We are aware of a growing disappointment among some of you with the delays we're experiencing with the Russian language update for Coteries of New York. We appreciate you reaching out to voice your concerns, and would like to assure you that we take them seriously. The delay we've experienced is down to a number of issues that kept pushing the release of the update further into 2021, but the good news is that we're almost there.

We are currently working to stamp out bugs that would otherwise plague the Russian version on release were we to publish the update sooner. Other than some minor issues that we'd still like to get rid off before passing the game on to you hands, we've also encountered a few bigger bugs that would impact all versions of the game. We are now focusing on dealing with those, so we can improve the state of the game for all fans of Vampire: The Masquerade around the world.

We would like to ask for just a little more patience, realizing that you've already given us plenty - but would like to pledge that we're between 5 and 10 working days from updating the game with the Russian language version, as well as other fixes and improvements. We are currently waiting for some updated files from one of our partners, and working hard on testing the game - hence there might still be some small delays that make it impossible for us to declare a specific day that the update will go live. We are, however, doing all we can so that it comes sooner rather than later.

We assure you, however, that the wait is almost over, and would like to thank you for your ongoing patience. We hope this upcoming update will allow you to enjoy our game and the story it tells to the fullest.

As always, you're most welcome to share your feedback on Steam or join our official Discord server, where you can talk directly with the developers.

Best regards,
Jacek @ Draw DIstance dev team


///


Здравствуйте, дорогие члены #vamily! Надеюсь, мое сообщение найдет вас хорошо!

У нас есть важная новость для нашего русского сообщества, касающаяся локализации Vampire: The Masquerade - Coteries of New York. Вот заявление ведущего проекта по Coteries:

Мы знаем о растущем разочаровании некоторых из вас по поводу задержек с обновлением русского языка для Coteries of New York. Мы благодарны вам за то, что вы обратились к нам, чтобы высказать свои опасения, и хотели бы заверить вас, что мы воспринимаем их всерьез. Задержка, которую мы испытали, сводится к ряду проблем, которые продолжали давить на выпуск обновления в 2021 году, но хорошая новость заключается в том, что мы почти на месте.

В настоящее время мы работаем над искоренением ошибок, которые в противном случае нанесли бы вред русской версии при выпуске, если бы мы опубликовали обновление раньше. Кроме некоторых незначительных проблем, от которых мы все еще хотели бы избавиться перед тем, как передать игру на руки, мы также столкнулись с несколькими более крупными ошибками, которые повлияли бы на все версии игры. Сейчас мы сосредоточились на их устранении, так что мы можем улучшить состояние игры для всех поклонников Vampire: The Masquerade по всему миру.

Мы хотели бы попросить немного больше терпения, понимая, что вы уже дали нам много - но хотели бы пообещать, что у нас есть от 5 до 10 рабочих дней с момента обновления игры русскоязычной версией, а также другие исправления и улучшения. В настоящее время мы ждем несколько обновленных файлов от одного из наших партнеров и усиленно работаем над тестированием игры - следовательно, могут остаться небольшие задержки, из-за которых мы не сможем объявить конкретный день, когда обновление вступит в силу. Однако мы делаем все возможное, чтобы оно пришло раньше, чем позже.

Уверяем вас, однако, что ожидание почти закончилось, и хотели бы поблагодарить вас за ваше постоянное терпение. Мы надеемся, что это предстоящее обновление позволит вам насладиться нашей игрой и сюжетом, который она рассказывает в полной мере.

Как всегда, вы можете поделиться своими отзывами о Steam или присоединиться к нашему официальному серверу Discord, где вы сможете напрямую пообщаться с разработчиками.

С наилучшими пожеланиями,
Jacek @ Draw DIstance Dev team

notes.title: VtM - Coteries of New York: Mac OS and Linux support; version 1.0.05 is live!

Hello dear members of #vamily, how are you?

We have an important piece of news to share:

Vampire: The Masquerade - Coteries of New York now supports Mac OS and Linux!

We're fully aware that many members of the VtM community were waiting for this update and we're very sorry that you had to wait more than a months since the game released to be able to launch Coteries of New York on Mac OS and Linux.

We want to assure you that we're working hard to add all the features we wanted to add from the very beginning, erasing bugs, correcting typos and negotiating the best possible deals to add more language versions.

We'll be supporting Coteries of New York in the upcoming months to make sure that you can enjoy the highest quality we're able to deliver.

Saying that, It's my pleasure to announce that the version 1.0.05 is now live, which means that we have implemented several fixes and removed number of issues:


Fixed unredacted text being displayed in log
Fixed slight text clipping on the dialogue box edges
Fixed slight text jumping on new line appearing
Fixed some resolution issues on wide monitors
Various fixed instances of the text not being attached to the proper character/narrator
Some audio fixes and improvements


Please remember that we're always open to your suggestions, because it's thanks to your feedback and engagement we're able to continuously improve Coteries of New York.

Thank you for supporting us!

All the best to you,

Draw Distance development team

notes.title: Coteries of New York PC release date confirmed!
notes.notes:
Hello dear members of #vamily!

We just returned from amazing PDXCon 2019 in Berlin, and we have a great info to share with you!

Vampire: The Masquerade – Coteries of New York will be released for PC (Windows, Linux, Mac OS) on December 4th 2019. The game will be available on Steam, GOG.com (DRM-free version) and globally through other digital outlets. The Nintendo Switch version of the game will be released in Q1 2020. 

But that’s not all! Currently we are actively exploring options for bringing the game to PS4 and Xbox One consoles.  We got a lot of requests for releasing the game on those major platforms and we want to make it happen if possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178762/f0ff9af0d6665e551d95949379c4b29d94949f5c.jpg

Last weekend Draw Distance attended PDXCON 2019 in Berlin where we presented a hands on demo of Vampire: The Masquerade – Coteries of New York! For two days players were able to play Coteries demo and we are happy to inform that the game got very positive feedback. Vampire: The Masquerade – Coteries of New York will also be presented at Game Connection 2019 in Paris, and you're most invited to meet with us there!

As always, we can't wait to listen to your feedback and share opinions with you. We invite anyone who  wants to chat with us about Vampire: The Masquerade – Coteries of New York  or our other games to join our official Discord:

Best regards,
Jacek @ Draw Distance dev team
